title: Microsoft completes its acquisition of speech-AI company Nuance, valued at about USD 16 billion
summary: TechXplore reports the closing of the deal, in which Microsoft adds Nuance's healthcare speech technology.

title: Researchers report a drug-discovery AI, run with its toxicity penalty inverted, proposed about 40,000 candidate toxic molecules in six hours
summary: The authors from Collaborations Pharmaceuticals describe the result as a dual-use risk for generative models in chemistry.

title: Italy's data protection authority fines Clearview AI EUR 20 million over biometric data collection
summary: BleepingComputer reports the fine for collecting Italians' biometric data.

title: Clearview AI's chief executive says he offered Ukraine's defence ministry free use of its facial-recognition search engine, Reuters reports
summary: DPL News, citing Reuters, says the letter lists uses such as screening people at checkpoints and identifying bodies, and that Clearview says it has not offered the tool to Russia.

title: Facebook says it removed a deepfake video claiming to show Zelenskyy urging surrender
summary: Ukrainian outlet Ukraina 24 said its news ticker was hacked by 'enemy hackers' to run a fake surrender message, and Zelenskyy called it a provocation.

title: China's party and state offices issue opinions on strengthening science and technology ethics governance, naming AI among priority fields
summary: The document calls for ethics review committees for AI research touching ethics-sensitive areas and for ethics legislation research during the 14th Five-Year Plan.

title: Nvidia launches the Hopper architecture and H100 GPU for AI data centres
summary: Nvidia says the chip has 80 billion transistors on TSMC's 4N process and the first PCIe Gen5 and HBM3 support in a GPU.

title: Japan's NEDO, AIST and University of Tokyo report working 'AI-One' prototype chip with six AI accelerators and a shared evaluation platform for startups
summary: Under NEDO's state-funded AI chip development acceleration programme, a 28nm demonstration chip carrying six different AI accelerators was confirmed to run at design clock speeds, alongside an evaluation platform offered to venture firms that the partners say cuts development and evaluation time to 45% or less.

title: DeepMind posts 'Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models', introducing the 70-billion-parameter Chinchilla
summary: The paper reports that a smaller model trained on more data outperforms larger models such as Gopher at the same compute budget.
